cases.name: daily-ledger-cashier-valid
setup_sql: INSERT INTO dl_branches (code, name, is_active) VALUES ('CAPFIX-DL', 'Capability Fixture Branch', 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), is_active = VALUES(is_active)

INSERT INTO dl_users (username, password_hash, full_name, role, is_active) VALUES ('cashier1', '$2y$10$fNkRk6B.XsE0UQ5pgUv80OdUdU9YWJAgd.AOfyMIdZ.WShuCqUzH2', 'Capability Fixture Cashier', 'cashier', 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE password_hash = VALUES(password_hash), full_name = VALUES(full_name), role = VALUES(role), is_active = VALUES(is_active)
INSERT IGNORE INTO dl_user_branches (user_id, branch_id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM dl_users WHERE username = 'cashier1' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM dl_branches WHERE code = 'CAPFIX-DL' LIMIT 1)
teardown_sql: DELETE FROM dl_user_branches WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM dl_users WHERE username = 'cashier1' LIMIT 1)
